title: Scalar extension on the bounded derived categories of finite-dimensional vector spaces
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and let $\mathcal E_\ell$ be the directed set of finite extensions $E'/\Ql$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] contained in $\Qlb$, as in the finite coefficient categories over a point [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]; for $E'\in\mathcal E_\ell$ let $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E')$ be the bounded derived category of finite-dimensional $E'$-vector spaces of that node, a full subcategory of the derived category $D(E')$ of $E'$-vector spaces [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $E'\subset L$ in $\mathcal E_\ell$, the *scalar extension* functor

$$
-\otimes_{E'}L:D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E')\longrightarrow D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(L)
$$

is defined on a complex $C'=(C'^r,d^r)$ of finite-dimensional $E'$-vector spaces termwise, $(C'\otimes_{E'}L)^r=C'^r\otimes_{E'}L$ with differentials $d^r\otimes_{E'}L$, using the extension of scalars of vector spaces [def-weil-vector-space-scalar-extension], and on a morphism of complexes termwise. The termwise functor $V\mapsto V\otimes_{E'}L$ is exact (it carries a basis to a basis, so it preserves kernels and images), hence it carries quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms and descends to a functor on the derived categories; it preserves boundedness and finite-dimensionality, so it lands in $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(L)$. For a tower $E'\subset L\subset M$ in $\mathcal E_\ell$ the canonical isomorphisms $(V\otimes_{E'}L)\otimes_LM\cong V\otimes_{E'}M$ give a canonical isomorphism of functors $(-\otimes_{E'}L)\otimes_LM\cong-\otimes_{E'}M$, and $-\otimes_{E'}E'$ is the identity; these are the transition functors of the directed system $(D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E'))_{E'\in\mathcal E_\ell}$ whose $2$-colimit is the stagewise $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)$ of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. The same definition applies with $L$ replaced by $\Qlb$ itself, giving $-\otimes_{E'}\Qlb:D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E')\to D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)_{\mathrm{naive}}$, the bounded derived category of finite-dimensional $\Qlb$-vector spaces.

source.place: node def-weil-finite-coefficient-point, order 1509: the 2-colimit $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)=\operatorname{2-colim}_{E\in\mathcal E_\ell}D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E)$, whose transition functors the blueprint does not write out; the transition functor $K\mapsto K\otimes_EL$ is the one named in def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients (order 1462) for $D^b_c(Y,E)$
